privacy.title: Privacy First
privacy.description: All processing happens in your browser

extension.title: Chrome Extension
extension.description: Remove watermarks with one click - right from your browser

overview.title: Overview
overview.content: CleanMark is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we handle your data when you use our Gemini watermark remover service.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: CleanMark does not collect, store, or transmit any user data, images, or personal information. We do not use cookies, analytics, or any tracking technologies.

localProcessing.title: Local Processing
localProcessing.content: All image processing happens entirely in your browser using client-side JavaScript. Your images never leave your device and are not sent to any server.

extension.title: Chrome Extension Permissions
extension.content: Our Chrome extension requires the following permissions:

permissions.webRequest: webRequest: Used only to intercept image URLs from Gemini servers to obtain full-resolution images. No data is collected or transmitted.
permissions.activeTab: activeTab: Used only to detect download actions on Gemini pages and inject the watermark removal functionality.
permissions.downloads: downloads: Used only to save processed images to your device's download folder.

thirdParty.title: Third-party Services
thirdParty.content: CleanMark does not use any third-party analytics, tracking, advertising, or data collection services. We do not share any information with third parties.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For questions about this privacy policy, please visit cleanmark.org or contact us through GitHub.
